title: Ilg‘or ergash gaplar va kesimsiz konstruksiyalar
goal_uz: Dars oxirida to‘liq ergash gaplarni sifatdoshli, mustaqil (absolute) va qisqartirilgan nisbiy konstruksiyalarga aylantira olasiz, o‘zbekcha ravishdoshlarning inglizcha muqobillarini to‘g‘ri tanlaysiz va bitta xatboshida kamida beshta qisqartirishni aniq, xatosiz qo‘llaysiz.

scenes.title: Ixcham va kuchli gaplar
board: Advanced clauses & reduced constructions
(Ilg‘or ergash gaplar va kesimsiz konstruksiyalar)
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda bitta fikrni turli so‘z va tuzilmalar bilan qayta ifodalashni o‘rgandik. Bugun shuni grammatik darajaga olib chiqamiz: to‘liq ergash gapni qisqa, kesimsiz birikmaga aylantiramiz. Dars oxirida bitta xatboshini beshta qisqartirish bilan, ma’nosini yo‘qotmay, ixcham va rasmiy qilib qayta yoza olasiz.
scenes.say: Welcome back. Last time we practised paraphrasing. Today we turn full clauses into compact, non-finite constructions. By the end, you will rewrite a paragraph using five reduced clauses.
scenes.say_uz: Xush kelibsiz. O‘tgan safar paraphrase ni mashq qildik. Bugun to‘liq gaplarni ixcham, kesimsiz konstruksiyalarga aylantiramiz. Oxirida bir xatboshini beshta qisqartirilgan birikma bilan qayta yozasiz.

scenes.title: Kesimsiz birikma nima?
board: finite: When she opened the door, she saw…
non-finite: Opening the door, she saw…
(kesim yo‘q: zamon va shaxs yo‘q)

examples.t: As I didn’t know the answer, I stayed silent.
examples.uz: Javobni bilmaganim uchun jim turdim.

examples.t: Not knowing the answer, I stayed silent.
examples.uz: Javobni bilmay, jim turdim.

scenes.say_native: Avval atama. To‘liq ergash gapda bog‘lovchi, ega va zamonli fe’l bor: when she opened. Kesimsiz birikmada zamon ham, shaxs ham yo‘q, faqat -ing, uchinchi shakl yoki to-infinitive qoladi: opening the door. Zamonni asosiy gap beradi. Bunday birikmalar asosan yozma, rasmiy va badiiy nutqda ishlatiladi va bir gapga ikki harakatni sig‘diradi.
scenes.say: A finite clause has a subject and a tense: when she opened the door. A non-finite clause drops both: opening the door.
scenes.say_uz: To‘liq gapda ega va zamon bor: when she opened the door. Kesimsiz birikmada ikkalasi tushib qoladi: opening the door.

scenes.title: -ing birikma: bir vaqtdagi harakat va sabab
board: V-ing, main clause → same time / reason
Walking along the river, we talked about work.
Feeling unwell, she left early. (= because she felt)

examples.t: Looking out of the window, he noticed a strange car.
examples.uz: Derazadan qarab turib, u g‘alati mashinani payqadi.

examples.t: Being a doctor, she knew exactly what to do.
examples.uz: Shifokor bo‘lgani uchun u nima qilishni aniq bilardi.

scenes.say_native: Birinchi tur: -ing bilan boshlanadigan birikma. U ikki ma’no beradi. Bir vaqtdagi harakat: walking along the river, ya’ni daryo bo‘ylab yurib. Yoki sabab: feeling unwell, o‘zini yomon his qilgani uchun. Being a doctor ham sabab. Qaysi ma’no ekanini kontekst ko‘rsatadi. Asosiy shart: -ing harakatini bajaruvchi asosiy gapning egasi bo‘lishi kerak.
scenes.say: Looking out of the window, he noticed a strange car. Being a doctor, she knew exactly what to do.
scenes.say_uz: Derazadan qarab turib, u g‘alati mashinani payqadi. Shifokor bo‘lgani uchun u nima qilishni aniq bilardi.

scenes.title: Having + V3: oldin bo‘lgan harakat
board: Having + past participle → earlier action
Having finished the report, she went home.
Having been warned, they took precautions. (passive)

examples.t: Having lived in Seoul for years, he speaks Korean fluently.
examples.uz: Seulda yillar davomida yashagani uchun u koreyschani ravon gapiradi.

examples.t: Having been rejected twice, the proposal was finally approved.
examples.uz: Ikki marta rad etilgach, taklif nihoyat ma’qullandi.

scenes.say_native: Agar bir harakat ikkinchisidan aniq oldin tugagan bo‘lsa, having va uchinchi shakl ishlatiladi: having finished the report, ya’ni hisobotni tugatib bo‘lgach. Majhul nisbatda having been: having been warned, ogohlantirilgach. Qisqa, ketma-ket harakatlarda oddiy -ing ham yetadi: opening the drawer, she took out a key. Ketma-ketlikni ta’kidlash kerak bo‘lsa, having aniqroq.
scenes.say: Having finished the report, she went home. Having been rejected twice, the proposal was finally approved. Use having plus a past participle when one action clearly comes first.
scenes.say_uz: Hisobotni tugatgach, u uyga ketdi. Ikki marta rad etilgach, taklif nihoyat ma’qullandi. Bir harakat aniq oldin bo‘lsa, having va uchinchi shaklni ishlating.

scenes.title: -ed birikma: majhul ma’no
board: V3 clause = passive meaning
Built in 1890, the bridge is still in use.
Asked about the delay, the minister refused to comment.

examples.t: Written in plain English, the guide is easy to follow.
examples.uz: Oddiy ingliz tilida yozilgani uchun qo‘llanmaga amal qilish oson.

examples.t: Left alone, the child began to cry.
examples.uz: Yolg‘iz qoldirilgach, bola yig‘lay boshladi.

scenes.say_native: Uchinchi shakl bilan boshlanadigan birikma majhul ma’no beradi. Built in 1890 bu which was built in 1890 degani: ko‘prikni qurishgan. Asked about the delay: vazirdan so‘rashdi. Bu shakl sabab yoki vaqtni ham bildiradi: written in plain English, ya’ni oddiy tilda yozilgani uchun. Bu yerda ham ega bir xil: ko‘prik qurilgan va ko‘prik ishlatilmoqda.
scenes.say: Built in 1890, the bridge is still in use. Asked about the delay, the minister refused to comment.
scenes.say_uz: 1890 yilda qurilgan ko‘prik hali ishlatilmoqda. Kechikish haqida so‘ralganda vazir izoh bermadi.

scenes.title: O‘zbek tilidagi ravishdosh bilan qiyos
board: -ib / -a turib → V-ing
-gach / -gandan keyin → Having + V3
-gani uchun → V-ing / Being…

examples.t: Hearing the news, she burst into tears.
examples.uz: Xabarni eshitib, u yig‘lab yubordi.

examples.t: Having read the contract, he signed it.
examples.uz: Shartnomani o‘qib chiqqach, u imzoladi.

scenes.say_native: Yaxshi xabar: o‘zbek tilida bu mexanizm juda tabiiy. Xabarni eshitib, u yig‘lab yubordi: eshitib aynan hearing the news ga to‘g‘ri keladi. O‘qib chiqqach esa having read. Bizda ham ravishdosh egasi asosiy gap egasi bilan bir xil. Farqi: o‘zbekchada bu shakl og‘zaki nutqda ham ko‘p, ingliz tilida esa og‘zaki nutqda ko‘proq to‘liq gap ishlatiladi.
scenes.say: Hearing the news, she burst into tears. Having read the contract, he signed it. In speech, people would often say: when she heard the news.
scenes.say_uz: Xabarni eshitib, u yig‘lab yubordi. Shartnomani o‘qib chiqqach, u imzoladi. Og‘zaki nutqda ko‘pincha when she heard the news deyiladi.

scenes.title: Inkor va bog‘lovchili birikmalar
board: Not + V-ing: Not wanting to wake him, I left quietly.
Never having flown before, she was nervous.
conjunction + V-ing/V3: While waiting… / If approved… / Once signed…

examples.t: While waiting for the train, I read the report.
examples.uz: Poyezdni kutayotib, hisobotni o‘qidim.

examples.t: If approved, the plan will start in May.
examples.uz: Agar ma’qullansa, reja may oyida boshlanadi.

scenes.say_native: Ikki tafsilot. Inkor birikma boshiga qo‘yiladi: not wanting to wake him, ya’ni uni uyg‘otishni istamay. Never ham shunday: never having flown before. Ma’noni aniqlashtirish uchun bog‘lovchini saqlash mumkin: while waiting, when asked, if approved, once signed. Shunda sabab, vaqt yoki shart ekanini o‘quvchi taxmin qilmaydi.
scenes.say: Not wanting to wake him, I left quietly. While waiting for the train, I read the report.
scenes.say_uz: Uni uyg‘otishni istamay, sekin chiqib ketdim. Poyezdni kutayotib, hisobotni o‘qidim.

scenes.title: Osilib qolgan sifatdosh
board: ✗ Walking home, the rain started.
✓ Walking home, I got caught in the rain.
✗ Having finished dinner, the dishes were washed. ✓ …, we washed the dishes.
scenes.say_native: Eng mashhur xato: dangling participle, ya’ni osilib qolgan sifatdosh. Walking home, the rain started desak, grammatik jihatdan yomg‘ir uyga ketayotgan bo‘lib chiqadi. To‘g‘risi: walking home, I got caught in the rain. Ikkinchi misolda ham kechki ovqatni idishlar yemagan, biz yeganmiz. Doim tekshiring: verguldan keyingi ega -ing ni bajaruvchimi?
scenes.say: Walking home, the rain started. That suggests the rain was walking home. Say instead: walking home, I got caught in the rain.
scenes.say_uz: Walking home, the rain started, bu yomg‘ir uyga ketayotgandek eshitiladi. Buning o‘rniga: walking home, I got caught in the rain.

scenes.title: Gaplarni birlashtiring
board: 1) She checked the figures. Then she sent the email. (Having…)
2) He didn’t know the way. He asked a passer-by. (Not…)
3) The book was translated into 30 languages. It became a bestseller.
4) I was sitting on the bus. I phoned my mother.
scenes.say_native: Endi navbat sizda. Har bir juftlikdagi ikki gapni bitta gapga birlashtiring, birinchisini sifatdoshli birikmaga aylantiring. Birinchisida having, ikkinchisida inkor, uchinchisida majhul shakl, to‘rtinchisida bir vaqtdagi harakat. Ega bir xil qolishini tekshiring va gapni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Combine each pair into one sentence, using a participle clause. Number one uses having, number two starts with not.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir juftlikni sifatdoshli birikma bilan bitta gapga birlashtiring. Birinchisida having, ikkinchisida not ishlating.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) Having checked the figures, she sent the email.
2) Not knowing the way, he asked a passer-by.
3) Translated into 30 languages, the book became a bestseller.
4) Sitting on the bus, I phoned my mother.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Having checked the figures, she sent the email, chunki tekshirish oldin tugagan. Not knowing the way, he asked a passer-by. Kitobni boshqalar tarjima qilgan: translated into thirty languages. Sitting on the bus, I phoned my mother. Uchinchi gapda the book verguldan keyin darhol kelishi shart.
scenes.say: Having checked the figures, she sent the email. Not knowing the way, he asked a passer-by.
scenes.say_uz: Raqamlarni tekshirib bo‘lgach, u xatni yubordi. Yo‘lni bilmay, u o‘tkinchidan so‘radi.

scenes.title: Mustaqil (absolute) birikma
board: noun + participle, main clause
The weather being fine, we ate outside.
The work done, they went home.

examples.t: Her hands shaking, she opened the letter.
examples.uz: Qo‘llari titrab, u xatni ochdi.

examples.t: The meeting having ended, the staff returned to their desks.
examples.uz: Yig‘ilish tugagach, xodimlar o‘z joylariga qaytishdi.

scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi mavzu: absolute construction. Bu birikmaning o‘z egasi bor va u asosiy gap egasidan farq qiladi. The weather being fine, we ate outside: ob-havo yaxshi bo‘lgani uchun tashqarida ovqatlandik. Her hands shaking: qo‘llari titrab. Bu shakl rasmiy yoki adabiy. O‘zbekchada ham bor: qo‘llari titrab, xatni ochdi. Demak, bu biz uchun tanish.
scenes.say: The weather being fine, we ate outside. Her hands shaking, she opened the letter.
scenes.say_uz: Ob-havo yaxshi bo‘lgani uchun tashqarida ovqatlandik. Qo‘llari titrab, u xatni ochdi.

scenes.title: With + absolute birikma
board: with + noun + V-ing / V3 / adjective / place
With prices rising, families are spending less.
With the exams over, students can relax.

examples.t: With so many people absent, the vote was postponed.
examples.uz: Shuncha ko‘p odam yo‘qligi sababli ovoz berish qoldirildi.

examples.t: He sat there with his eyes closed.
examples.uz: U ko‘zlarini yumib o‘tirardi.

scenes.say_native: Zamonaviy nutqda absolute birikma ko‘pincha with bilan boshlanadi. With prices rising: narxlar o‘sayotgani sababli. With the exams over: imtihonlar tugagach. With dan keyin ot, keyin -ing, uchinchi shakl, sifat yoki joy keladi: with his eyes closed, ko‘zlari yumuq holda. Bu being li variantdan ancha tabiiy, shuning uchun nutqda with ni ko‘proq ishlating.
scenes.say: With prices rising, families are spending less. With the exams over, students can relax.
scenes.say_uz: Narxlar o‘sayotgani uchun oilalar kamroq sarflamoqda. Imtihonlar tugagach, talabalar dam olishi mumkin.

scenes.title: Turg‘un absolute iboralar
board: Weather permitting, … (ob-havo imkon bersa)
All things considered, … · Other things being equal, …
There being no further business, the meeting closed.

examples.t: Weather permitting, we’ll hike to the lake tomorrow.
examples.uz: Ob-havo imkon bersa, ertaga ko‘lga piyoda boramiz.

examples.t: All things considered, the launch was a success.
examples.uz: Hamma narsani hisobga olganda, taqdimot muvaffaqiyatli o‘tdi.

scenes.say_native: Ba’zi absolute birikmalar turg‘un iboraga aylangan. Weather permitting: ob-havo imkon bersa. Time permitting: vaqt yetsa. All things considered: hamma narsani hisobga olganda. Other things being equal iqtisodiy matnlarda ko‘p. There being no further business esa yig‘ilish bayonnomalariga xos: boshqa masala bo‘lmagani uchun yig‘ilish yopildi.
scenes.say: Weather permitting, we’ll hike to the lake tomorrow. All things considered, the launch was a success.
scenes.say_uz: Ob-havo imkon bersa, ertaga ko‘lga piyoda boramiz. Hamma narsani hisobga olganda, taqdimot muvaffaqiyatli o‘tdi.

scenes.title: Ega tushib qolgan absolute
board: ✗ Being Sunday, the shops were closed.
✓ It being Sunday, the shops were closed.
✓✓ As it was Sunday, the shops were closed.
scenes.say_native: Ko‘p uchraydigan xato: being Sunday, the shops were closed. Bunda being ning egasi do‘konlar bo‘lib qoladi. Absolute birikmada egani yozish kerak: it being Sunday. Lekin bu kitobiy eshitiladi. Zamonaviy ingliz tilida eng yaxshisi to‘liq gap: as it was Sunday. Qoida oddiy: ega farq qilsa, uni tashlab ketmang.
scenes.say: Not: being Sunday, the shops were closed. You need: it being Sunday. Even better: as it was Sunday, the shops were closed.
scenes.say_uz: Being Sunday, the shops were closed emas. Kerakli shakl: it being Sunday. Undan ham yaxshisi: as it was Sunday, the shops were closed.

scenes.title: Absolute birikma tuzing
board: 1) Because the deadline was approaching, we worked late. (With…)
2) After the speech had ended, the audience applauded.
3) If the weather allows, the match will go ahead.
4) She stood at the door. Her arms were folded. (with)
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta gapni absolute birikma bilan qayta yozing. Birinchi va to‘rtinchisida with ishlating. Ikkinchisida having li shaklni sinang, chunki nutq asosiy harakatdan oldin tugagan. Uchinchisi uchun hozirgina o‘rgangan turg‘un iborani eslang. Har bir birikmaning o‘z egasi borligini tekshiring.
scenes.say: Rewrite each sentence with an absolute construction. Use with in numbers one and four.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir gapni absolute konstruksiya bilan qayta yozing. Birinchi va to‘rtinchisida with ishlating.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) With the deadline approaching, we worked late.
2) The speech having ended, the audience applauded.
3) Weather permitting, the match will go ahead.
4) She stood at the door with her arms folded.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. With the deadline approaching, we worked late. The speech having ended, the audience applauded; bu juda rasmiy, with the speech over tabiiyroq. Weather permitting, the match will go ahead. She stood at the door with her arms folded: qo‘llar o‘zi qovushmaydi, ularni qovushtirishadi, shuning uchun uchinchi shakl.
scenes.say: With the deadline approaching, we worked late. The speech having ended, the audience applauded.
scenes.say_uz: Muddat yaqinlashayotgani uchun kech ishladik. Nutq tugagach, tomoshabinlar qarsak chalishdi.

scenes.title: Qisqartirilgan nisbiy gap: -ing
board: who/which + be + V-ing → V-ing
who/which + active verb → V-ing
The woman (who is) talking to Tom is my boss.

examples.t: Anyone wishing to attend should register online.
examples.uz: Qatnashmoqchi bo‘lgan har kim onlayn ro‘yxatdan o‘tishi kerak.

examples.t: Students living on campus pay lower fees.
examples.uz: Kampusda yashaydigan talabalar kamroq to‘laydi.

scenes.say_native: Uchinchi mavzu: qisqartirilgan nisbiy gap. Who is talking dan who is tushib, talking qoladi. Oddiy faol fe’l ham -ing ga aylanadi: students who live on campus o‘rniga students living on campus. Anyone who wishes to attend esa anyone wishing to attend. Bu shakl doimiy holat yoki davom etayotgan harakatga mos va rasmiy e’lonlarda juda keng tarqalgan.
scenes.say: The woman talking to Tom is my boss. Students living on campus pay lower fees.
scenes.say_uz: Tom bilan gaplashayotgan ayol mening boshlig‘im. Kampusda yashaydigan talabalar kamroq to‘laydi.

scenes.title: Qisqartirilgan nisbiy gap: -ed va being
board: which was/were + V3 → V3
The report (which was) published last week…
The bridge (which is) being built… (davom etayotgan majhul)

examples.t: Most of the goods sold online are shipped within a day.
examples.uz: Onlayn sotilgan mahsulotlarning ko‘pi bir kun ichida jo‘natiladi.

examples.t: The issues being discussed today are complex.
examples.uz: Bugun muhokama qilinayotgan masalalar murakkab.

scenes.say_native: Majhul nisbiy gap ham shunday qisqaradi: the report which was published last week bo‘ladi the report published last week. Zamon yo‘qoladi, shuning uchun bitta shakl turli zamonlarga yaraydi: goods sold online. Harakat ayni paytda davom etayotgan bo‘lsa, being qo‘shiladi: the bridge being built, hozir qurilayotgan ko‘prik. The bridge built esa qurib bo‘lingan.
scenes.say: The report published last week caused a stir. The bridge being built near the station will open next year. Being shows the action is still in progress.
scenes.say_uz: O‘tgan hafta e’lon qilingan hisobot shov-shuv bo‘ldi. Bekat yonida qurilayotgan ko‘prik kelasi yili ochiladi. Being harakat hali davom etayotganini ko‘rsatadi.

scenes.title: To-infinitive bilan qisqartirish
board: the first / last / only + to-infinitive
She was the first woman to win the prize.
the issue to be discussed (muhokama qilinishi kerak bo‘lgan)

examples.t: He was the last person to leave the building.
examples.uz: U binodan chiqib ketgan oxirgi odam edi.

examples.t: The main problem to be solved is funding.
examples.uz: Hal qilinishi kerak bo‘lgan asosiy muammo moliyalashtirish.

scenes.say_native: First, last, next va only dan keyin nisbiy gap to-infinitive ga aylanadi: the first woman who won the prize o‘rniga the first woman to win the prize. Ikkinchi holat: majburiy yoki kelajakdagi ma’no: the problem to be solved, hal qilinishi kerak bo‘lgan muammo. Bu yerda -ing ishlatilmaydi: the first woman winning the prize xato.
scenes.say: She was the first woman to win the prize. He was the last person to leave the building.
scenes.say_uz: U mukofotni yutgan birinchi ayol edi. U binodan chiqqan oxirgi odam edi.

scenes.title: Sifat va izohli qisqartirish
board: people (who are) aware of the risks
a task (that is) impossible to finish on time
Samarkand, (which is) a UNESCO World Heritage site, …

examples.t: Candidates fluent in Arabic are encouraged to apply.
examples.uz: Arab tilini ravon biladigan nomzodlar ariza berishga taklif etiladi.

examples.t: Samarkand, a UNESCO World Heritage site, attracts many visitors.
examples.uz: YUNESKO ro‘yxatidagi Samarqand ko‘plab sayyohlarni jalb qiladi.

scenes.say_native: Who is dan keyin sifat yoki ot birikmasi kelsa ham qisqartirish mumkin. Candidates who are fluent in Arabic bo‘ladi candidates fluent in Arabic; sifatning to‘ldiruvchisi bor, shuning uchun u otdan keyin turadi. Ot birikmasi bilan izoh hosil bo‘ladi: Samarkand, a UNESCO World Heritage site, attracts many visitors. Izoh vergul bilan ajratiladi.
scenes.say: Candidates fluent in Arabic are encouraged to apply. Samarkand, a UNESCO World Heritage site, attracts many visitors.
scenes.say_uz: Arab tilini ravon biladigan nomzodlar ariza berishga taklif etiladi. YUNESKO merosi bo‘lgan Samarqand ko‘p sayyoh jalb qiladi.

scenes.title: So‘z tartibi: o‘zbekcha va inglizcha
board: kecha nashr etilgan hisobot → the report published yesterday
a broken window (1 so‘z: oldin)
the window broken in the storm (birikma: keyin)

examples.t: a smiling child
examples.uz: jilmayayotgan bola

examples.t: the child smiling at the camera
examples.uz: kameraga jilmayayotgan bola

scenes.say_native: O‘zbekchada sifatdosh birikma doim otdan oldin keladi: kecha nashr etilgan hisobot. Ingliz tilida esa yolg‘iz sifatdosh otdan oldin turadi: a broken window, a smiling child. Unga qo‘shimcha so‘zlar ergashsa, butun birikma otdan keyin o‘tadi: the window broken in the storm. O‘zbek tartibini ko‘chirish eng ko‘p uchraydigan xatolardan biri.
scenes.say: A smiling child. The child smiling at the camera. A single participle goes before the noun; a participle with its own words follows it.
scenes.say_uz: Jilmayayotgan bola. Kameraga jilmayayotgan bola. Yakka sifatdosh otdan oldin, o‘z so‘zlari bor sifatdosh esa otdan keyin keladi.

scenes.title: Nisbiy gapni qisqartirishdagi xatolar
board: ✗ the published last week report → ✓ the report published last week
✗ The man stealing the car yesterday was arrested. → ✓ The man who stole…
✗ the first to landed → ✓ the first to land
scenes.say_native: Uchta xato. Birinchisi, o‘zbek tartibi: the published last week report emas, the report published last week. Ikkinchisi nozik: -ing bilan qisqartirish bir martalik, tugagan o‘tgan harakatga to‘g‘ri kelmaydi. The man stealing the car yesterday tabiiy emas, to‘liq gap kerak: the man who stole the car. Uchinchisi: to dan keyin birinchi shakl: the first to land.
scenes.say: Not: the published last week report, but the report published last week. Not: the man stealing the car yesterday, but the man who stole the car yesterday.
scenes.say_uz: The published last week report emas, the report published last week. The man stealing the car yesterday emas, the man who stole the car yesterday.

scenes.title: Nisbiy gapni qisqartiring
board: 1) Applicants who have a driving licence will be preferred.
2) The museum, which was founded in 1876, reopened last year.
3) She was the only student who answered correctly.
4) The roads which are being repaired are closed to traffic.
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Har bir gapdagi nisbiy ergash gapni qisqartiring. Avval turini aniqlang: faol, majhul, to-infinitive yoki davom etayotgan majhul. Birinchi gapdagi have fe’lini qanday ifodalaysiz? To‘rtinchisida being ni saqlash kerakmi, o‘ylab ko‘ring. Keyin to‘liq gapni ayting.
scenes.say: Reduce each relative clause. Decide first: active, passive, infinitive, or passive in progress?
scenes.say_uz: Har bir nisbiy gapni qisqartiring. Avval aniqlang: faol, majhul, infinitive yoki davom etayotgan majhul?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) Applicants having / with a driving licence…
2) The museum, founded in 1876, reopened last year.
3) She was the only student to answer correctly.
4) The roads being repaired are closed to traffic.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Applicants having a driving licence mumkin, lekin eng tabiiysi applicants with a driving licence. The museum, founded in 1876, reopened last year, vergullar saqlanadi. The only student to answer correctly. The roads being repaired, chunki ta’mir davom etmoqda; the roads repaired desangiz, ta’mir tugagan bo‘lib chiqadi.
scenes.say: Applicants with a driving licence will be preferred. The museum, founded in 1876, reopened last year.
scenes.say_uz: Haydovchilik guvohnomasi bor nomzodlarga ustunlik beriladi. 1876 yilda tashkil etilgan muzey qayta ochildi.

scenes.title: Tinglash: yangiliklar
board: News bulletin
Listen for: reduced clauses
(qisqartirilgan birikmalarni toping)
scenes.say_native: Endi qisqa radio yangiligini tinglang. Yangiliklar ixchamlikni yaxshi ko‘radi, shuning uchun bu yerda bugungi konstruksiyalar ko‘p. E’tibor bering: stadion qachon va qayerda quriladi, kim xavotir bildirdi. Qisqartirilgan birikmalarni ham sanab boring.
scenes.say: Plans for a new stadium, approved by the city council last night, will see construction begin in March. The stadium, located on the northern edge of the city, will seat forty thousand fans. Residents living near the site have raised concerns about traffic. Asked about these concerns, the mayor promised a new bus line.
scenes.say_uz: Kecha shahar kengashi ma’qullagan yangi stadion rejasiga ko‘ra qurilish martda boshlanadi. Shaharning shimoliy chekkasida joylashgan stadion qirq ming muxlisni sig‘diradi. Hudud yaqinida yashovchi aholi transport bo‘yicha xavotir bildirdi. Bu haqda so‘ralganda mer yangi avtobus yo‘nalishini va’da qildi.

scenes.title: Yangilik bo‘yicha savollar
board: 1) Who approved the plans, and when?
2) Where will the stadium be?
3) Who is worried, and about what?
4) Find two past participle clauses.
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta savol. Rejani kim va qachon ma’qulladi? Stadion qayerda quriladi? Kim xavotirda va nima haqida? To‘rtinchi savol grammatik: matndan uchinchi shakl bilan boshlanadigan ikkita birikmani toping. Javobni to‘liq inglizcha gap bilan ayting, iloji bo‘lsa o‘zingiz ham qisqartirilgan birikma ishlating.
scenes.say: Who approved the plans, and when? Where will the stadium be? Who is worried, and about what? Find two past participle clauses.
scenes.say_uz: Rejani kim va qachon ma’qulladi? Stadion qayerda bo‘ladi? Kim va nima haqida xavotirda? Ikkita uchinchi shakl birikmasini toping.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) The city council, last night.
2) On the northern edge of the city.
3) Local residents, about traffic.
4) approved by…, located on…, asked about… (+ expected)
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Rejani shahar kengashi kecha kechqurun ma’qulladi. Stadion shaharning shimoliy chekkasida bo‘ladi. Yaqin atrofdagi aholi transportdan xavotirda. Uchinchi shakl birikmalari: approved by the city council, located on the northern edge va asked about these concerns. Residents living near the site esa -ing li nisbiy gap.
scenes.say: The city council approved the plans last night. The stadium will be on the northern edge of the city.
scenes.say_uz: Rejani shahar kengashi kecha kechqurun ma’qulladi. Stadion shaharning shimoliy chekkasida bo‘ladi.

scenes.title: Ravishdosh muqobillari: predlog + -ing
board: -gach → after / on (upon) + V-ing
-masdan → without + V-ing
-ib (usul) → by + V-ing

examples.t: On arriving at the hotel, we were given our keys.
examples.uz: Mehmonxonaga yetib kelishimiz bilan bizga kalitlar berildi.

examples.t: She left without saying goodbye.
examples.uz: U xayrlashmasdan ketdi.

scenes.say_native: To‘rtinchi mavzu: ravishdoshlarning muqobillari. O‘zbekchada -gach, -masdan, -ib kabi qo‘shimchalar bor. Ingliz tilida ularni predlog va -ing beradi. On yoki upon arriving: yetib kelishi bilan. Without saying goodbye: xayrlashmasdan. By practising: mashq qilib, ya’ni usul. After, before, since dan keyin ham -ing. Predlogdan keyin fe’l doim -ing shaklida.
scenes.say: On arriving at the hotel, we were given our keys. She left without saying goodbye.
scenes.say_uz: Mehmonxonaga yetib kelishimiz bilan bizga kalitlar berildi. U xayrlashmasdan ketdi.

scenes.title: Maqsad va natija
board: -ish uchun → to / in order to / so as to + V
… , making / leaving / causing … (natija)
Prices rose by 20%, making housing unaffordable.

examples.t: We left early so as not to miss the train.
examples.uz: Poyezdga kechikmaslik uchun erta chiqdik.

examples.t: The factory closed, leaving 500 people without work.
examples.uz: Zavod yopilib, besh yuz kishi ishsiz qoldi.

scenes.say_native: Maqsadni bildiruvchi -ish uchun ga to-infinitive mos keladi: to save time, in order to, so as to. Inkorda not to oldidan: so as not to miss. Natija uchun esa gap oxiridagi -ing birikma: zavod yopilib, besh yuz kishi ishsiz qoldi, ya’ni the factory closed, leaving five hundred people without work. Bu -ing butun oldingi gapga ishora qiladi va akademik yozuvda qadrlanadi.
scenes.say: We left early so as not to miss the train. The factory closed, leaving five hundred people without work. A final ing clause expresses a result.
scenes.say_uz: Poyezdga kechikmaslik uchun erta chiqdik. Zavod yopilib, besh yuz kishi ishsiz qoldi. Gap oxiridagi -ing birikma natijani bildiradi.

scenes.title: Predlogdan keyin infinitive
board: ✗ After to finish the call… → ✓ After finishing the call…
✗ without to say → ✓ without saying
✗ Before leaving, the lights must be switched off. → ✓ Before leaving, switch off the lights.
scenes.say_native: Ikki xil xato. Birinchisi, rus tilidagi infinitive odatidan: after to finish, without to say. Predlogdan keyin faqat -ing: after finishing, without saying. Ikkinchisi yana osilib qolgan konstruksiya: before leaving, the lights must be switched off. Chiqib ketayotgan chiroqlar emas, siz. Buyruq shaklini ishlating: before leaving, switch off the lights.
scenes.say: Not: after to finish the call, but after finishing the call. Not: without to say, but without saying. Before leaving, please switch off the lights.
scenes.say_uz: After to finish the call emas, after finishing the call. Without to say emas, without saying. Chiqishdan oldin chiroqlarni o‘chiring.

scenes.title: O‘zbekchadan tarjima
board: 1) Hisobotni o‘qib chiqmasdan uni imzolamang.
2) Toshkentga yetib kelishi bilan u bizga qo‘ng‘iroq qildi.
3) Daryo toshib, yuzlab uylarni suv bosdi.
4) U ingliz tilini filmlar ko‘rib o‘rgandi.
scenes.say_native: Endi teskari yo‘nalish. To‘rtta o‘zbekcha gapni inglizchaga tarjima qiling. Birinchisida -masdan, ikkinchisida -ishi bilan, uchinchisida natija, to‘rtinchisida usul bor. Har biri uchun qaysi predlog yoki shakl kerakligini o‘ylang va gapni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Translate into English. Use without, on, a result clause, and by.
scenes.say_uz: Inglizchaga tarjima qiling. Without, on, natija birikmasi va by ni ishlating.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) Don’t sign the report without reading it.
2) On / Upon arriving in Tashkent, he called us.
3) The river burst its banks, flooding hundreds of homes.
4) He learnt English by watching films.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Don’t sign the report without reading it. On arriving in Tashkent, he called us; arrive dan keyin shahar oldida in keladi. The river burst its banks, flooding hundreds of homes, bu natija. He learnt English by watching films. Amerika variantida learned, Britaniyada ikkalasi ham ishlatiladi.
scenes.say: Don’t sign the report without reading it. On arriving in Tashkent, he called us. The river burst its banks, flooding hundreds of homes.
scenes.say_uz: Hisobotni o‘qimasdan imzolamang. Toshkentga yetib kelishi bilan u bizga qo‘ng‘iroq qildi. Daryo toshib, yuzlab uylarni suv bosdi.

scenes.title: Uslub: qachon qisqartirish kerak?
board: ✓ formal writing, news, reports, academic texts
≈ speech: full clauses are more natural
Reduce when the link (time, reason, condition) is clear

examples.t: Because the survey was conducted online, it excluded older people.
examples.uz: So‘rovnoma onlayn o‘tkazilgani uchun keksalar qamrab olinmadi.

examples.t: Conducted online, the survey excluded older people.
examples.uz: Onlayn o‘tkazilgan so‘rovnoma keksalarni qamrab olmadi.

scenes.say_native: Endi uslub va aniqlik. Qisqartirish rasmiy yozuvda, yangilik, hisobot va ilmiy matnda o‘rinli. Do‘st bilan suhbatda having finished my dinner g‘alati eshitiladi. Agar sabab yoki qarama-qarshilik munosabati qisqartirganda yo‘qolsa, to‘liq gapni qoldiring yoki bog‘lovchini saqlang. Ixchamlik aniqlik hisobiga bo‘lmasligi kerak.
scenes.say: Conducted online, the survey excluded older people. It’s correct, but because it was conducted online makes the cause explicit. Reduce only when the link stays obvious.
scenes.say_uz: Onlayn o‘tkazilgan so‘rovnoma keksalarni qamrab olmadi. Bu to‘g‘ri, lekin because it was conducted online sababni aniq ko‘rsatadi. Bog‘lanish ravshan qolsagina qisqartiring.

scenes.title: Ruxsat etilgan istisnolar
board: Generally speaking, … · Judging by …
Considering …, · Given (that) …
Having said that, … (shunday bo‘lsa-da)

examples.t: Judging by the reviews, the film is worth seeing.
examples.uz: Sharhlarga qaraganda, film ko‘rishga arziydi.

examples.t: Given the time available, we did a good job.
examples.uz: Mavjud vaqtni hisobga olsak, yaxshi ishladik.

scenes.say_native: Muhim istisno. Ba’zi iboralar egasiz bo‘lsa ham to‘g‘ri hisoblanadi, chunki ular bog‘lovchiga aylangan: generally speaking, judging by, considering, given, having said that. Judging by the reviews, the film is worth seeing: kim baholayotgani muhim emas. Bu iboralar nutqni tabiiy va ishonchli qiladi.
scenes.say: Judging by the reviews, the film is worth seeing. Given the time available, we did a good job.
scenes.say_uz: Sharhlarga qaraganda, film ko‘rishga arziydi. Mavjud vaqtni hisobga olsak, yaxshi ishladik.

scenes.title: Ortiqcha yuklangan gap
board: ✗ Having been founded in 2010, located in Tashkent, employing 200 staff, the firm, known for…
✓ Founded in 2010, the Tashkent-based firm employs 200 staff.
Max 1–2 reductions per sentence
scenes.say_native: Yangi konstruksiyalarni hamma joyga tiqish ham xato. Having been founded in 2010, located in Tashkent, employing two hundred staff, the firm... Bunday gapni o‘quvchi uch marta o‘qiydi. Bitta gapda bir-ikkita qisqartirish yetarli: founded in 2010, the Tashkent-based firm employs two hundred staff. Qolganini keyingi gapga o‘tkazing.
scenes.say: Founded in 2010, the Tashkent-based firm employs two hundred staff. It is best known for its accounting software.
scenes.say_uz: 2010 yilda tashkil etilgan, Toshkentdagi firma ikki yuz xodimni ishlatadi. U buxgalteriya dasturi bilan mashhur.

scenes.title: Tinglash: muharrir bilan suhbat
board: Editor: This sentence is ambiguous.
Writer: Should I use a full clause?
Editor: Keep the conjunction.
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog. Jurnal muharriri yosh muallif bilan uning maqolasini muhokama qilmoqda. Tinglang: bitta gapda qanday muammo bor, muharrir qanday ikki yechim taklif qiladi va muallif oxirida qaysi birini tanlaydi. Bugun o‘rgangan xato shu suhbatda tabiiy ravishda uchraydi.
scenes.say: Editor: Look at this line. Having reviewed the data, the conclusion seems clear. Who reviewed the data? Writer: The researchers. Editor: But the sentence says the conclusion did. Either make the researchers the subject, or use a full clause. Writer: Then: having reviewed the data, the researchers reached a clear conclusion. Editor: Much better.
scenes.say_uz: Muharrir: Bu qatorga qarang. Ma’lumotlarni ko‘rib chiqib, xulosa aniq ko‘rinadi. Kim ko‘rib chiqdi? Muallif: Tadqiqotchilar. Muharrir: Lekin gapda buni xulosa qilgandek. Yo tadqiqotchilarni ega qiling, yo to‘liq gap ishlating. Muallif: Unda: ma’lumotlarni ko‘rib chiqib, tadqiqotchilar aniq xulosaga kelishdi. Muharrir: Ancha yaxshi.

scenes.title: Dialog bo‘yicha savollar
board: 1) What is wrong with the original sentence?
2) What two solutions does the editor offer?
3) Which one does the writer choose?
scenes.say_native: Uchta savol. Asl gapda qanday xato bor edi va bu xatoning nomi nima? Muharrir qanday ikkita yechim taklif qildi? Muallif qaysi yechimni tanladi va nega bu yechim yaxshi? Javobni inglizcha, to‘liq gap bilan ayting va bugun o‘rgangan atamalarni ishlatishga harakat qiling.
scenes.say: What was wrong with the original sentence? What two solutions did the editor offer? Which did the writer choose?
scenes.say_uz: Asl gapda nima xato edi? Muharrir qanday ikki yechim taklif qildi? Muallif qaysi birini tanladi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) A dangling participle: the conclusion ‘reviewed’ the data.
2) Make the researchers the subject, or use a full clause.
3) The first: the researchers become the subject.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Asl gapda dangling participle bor edi: grammatik jihatdan xulosa ma’lumotlarni ko‘rib chiqqandek. Muharrir yo tadqiqotchilarni ega qilishni, yo to‘liq gap ishlatishni taklif qildi, masalan after the researchers had reviewed the data. Muallif birinchi yo‘lni tanladi va gap ham aniq, ham ixcham qoldi.
scenes.say: It had a dangling participle. The editor suggested making the researchers the subject or using a full clause.
scenes.say_uz: Unda osilib qolgan sifatdosh bor edi. Muharrir tadqiqotchilarni ega qilishni yoki to‘liq gapni taklif qildi.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: ohang va to‘xtam
board: Having finished the report, | she went home.
fronted clause → its own tone unit, often rising (↗)
main clause → falling tone (↘)

examples.t: Weather permitting, | we’ll start at nine.
examples.uz: Ob-havo imkon bersa, to‘qqizda boshlaymiz.

scenes.say_native: Endi og‘zaki nutq. Gap boshiga chiqarilgan birikma alohida ohang guruhini hosil qiladi. Vergul o‘rnida qisqa to‘xtam bo‘ladi va ohang ko‘pincha ko‘tariladi, bu gap hali tugamaganini bildiradi. Asosiy gap oxirida ohang pastga tushadi. Having so‘zida urg‘u birinchi bo‘g‘inda. Bu ritm nutqingizni ishonchli qiladi.
scenes.say: Having finished the report, she went home. Weather permitting, we’ll start at nine. Notice the short pause, the slight rise, then the fall at the end.
scenes.say_uz: Hisobotni tugatib, u uyga ketdi. Ob-havo imkon bersa, to‘qqizda boshlaymiz. Qisqa to‘xtam, biroz ko‘tarilish va oxirida pasayishga e’tibor bering.

scenes.title: Xatboshini qayta yozing
board: The company, which was founded in 1998, makes solar panels. After it had expanded into Asia, it opened a factory which employs 300 people.
Because demand was growing, it hired engineers who were trained in Germany. Prices fell, and this made the panels affordable.
scenes.say_native: Asosiy yozma topshiriq. Ekrandagi xatboshida beshta joyni qisqartirish mumkin. Uni qayta yozing: kamida bitta having li birikma, bitta with li absolute, ikkita qisqartirilgan nisbiy gap va bitta natija birikmasi bo‘lsin. Ma’no o‘zgarmasin va hech bir sifatdosh osilib qolmasin. Yozing, keyin baland ovozda o‘qing.
scenes.say: Read the paragraph on the board and rewrite it with five reduced clauses. Keep the meaning, and check every subject.
scenes.say_uz: Ekrandagi xatboshini o‘qing va uni beshta qisqartirilgan birikma bilan qayta yozing. Ma’noni saqlang va har bir egani tekshiring.

scenes.title: Namuna javob
board: The company, founded in 1998, makes solar panels.
Having expanded into Asia, it opened a factory employing 300 people.
With demand growing, it hired engineers trained in Germany.
Prices fell, making the panels affordable.
scenes.say_native: Namuna javob. Founded in 1998: majhul nisbiy gap qisqardi. Having expanded into Asia: oldin bo‘lgan harakat. A factory employing three hundred people: faol nisbiy gap. With demand growing: ega boshqa, shuning uchun with. Engineers trained in Germany va oxirida natija: making the panels affordable. Sizning variantingiz biroz boshqacha bo‘lishi mumkin.
scenes.say: The company, founded in 1998, makes solar panels. Having expanded into Asia, it opened a factory employing three hundred people.
scenes.say_uz: 1998 yilda tashkil etilgan kompaniya quyosh panellari ishlab chiqaradi. Osiyoga kengaygach, u uch yuz kishi ishlaydigan zavod ochdi.

scenes.title: Og‘zaki topshiriq
board: Describe a recent achievement in 4–5 sentences.
Use: Having… · With… · a noun + V-ing/V3 · by + V-ing
Start: Having spent months preparing, I…
scenes.say_native: Og‘zaki mashq. Yaqinda erishgan bir yutug‘ingiz haqida to‘rt-besh gap ayting: imtihon, loyiha yoki sport. Kamida bitta having, bitta with, bitta qisqartirilgan nisbiy gap va bitta by bilan usul ishlating. Boshlang‘ich birikmadan keyin qisqa to‘xtam qiling. Tayyormisiz? Boshlang.
scenes.say: Describe a recent achievement in four or five sentences. You could begin: having spent months preparing, I finally passed my driving test.
scenes.say_uz: Yaqindagi bir yutug‘ingizni to‘rt-besh gapda tasvirlang. Masalan: oylab tayyorgarlik ko‘rib, nihoyat haydovchilik imtihonidan o‘tdim.

scenes.title: Namuna nutq
board: Having spent months preparing, I finally passed my IELTS exam.
With my scores improving, I felt more confident.
I studied with a group of friends taking the same test,
and I improved my writing by analysing model essays.
scenes.say_native: Mana namuna. To‘rtta gapda to‘rt xil konstruksiya bor: having spent months preparing, with my scores improving, friends taking the same test va by analysing model essays. Nutq esa sun’iy eshitilmaydi. E’tibor bering: analysing Britaniya imlosida s bilan, Amerikada z bilan yoziladi.
scenes.say: Having spent months preparing, I finally passed my IELTS exam. With my scores improving, I felt more confident.
scenes.say_uz: Oylab tayyorgarlik ko‘rib, nihoyat IELTS imtihonidan o‘tdim. Ballarim yaxshilangani sari ishonchim ortdi.

scenes.title: Xulosa
board: V-ing / Having V3 / V3 clauses: same subject!
Absolute: own subject · With + noun + participle
Reduced relatives: V-ing · V3 · being V3 · to-inf.
prep + V-ing: on, without, by, before, since
scenes.say_native: Xulosa. Birinchi: -ing, having va uchinchi shakl birikmalarida ega asosiy gap egasi bilan bir xil. Ikkinchi: absolute birikmaning o‘z egasi bor, ko‘pincha with bilan. Uchinchi: nisbiy gaplar -ing, uchinchi shakl, being yoki to-infinitive ga qisqaradi va uzun birikma otdan keyin turadi. To‘rtinchi: ravishdoshlar muqobili predlog va -ing. Va ixchamlik aniqlik hisobiga bo‘lmasin.
scenes.say: Participle clauses need the same subject as the main clause. Absolute clauses have their own subject. Relative clauses reduce to participles or infinitives. Clarity comes first.
scenes.say_uz: Sifatdoshli birikmada ega asosiy gap egasi bilan bir xil. Absolute birikmaning o‘z egasi bor. Nisbiy gaplar sifatdosh yoki infinitive ga qisqaradi. Aniqlik birinchi o‘rinda.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi
board: Homework: rewrite a paragraph using 5 reduced clauses
Check: same subject · meaning kept · max 2 per sentence
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: biror inglizcha xatboshini, masalan o‘z inshoingiz yoki yangilik matnini olib, beshta qisqartirilgan birikma bilan qayta yozing. Mezon: kamida uch xil tur ishlatilgan, birorta sifatdosh osilib qolmagan, ma’no o‘zgarmagan, bitta gapda ikkitadan ortiq qisqartirish yo‘q. Keyingi darsda ish yozishmalari va hisobotlar yozishni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: For homework, rewrite a paragraph using five reduced clauses, with no dangling participles. Next time: business correspondence and reports.
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifasi: bir xatboshini beshta qisqartirilgan birikma bilan, osilib qolgan sifatdoshlarsiz qayta yozing. Keyingi dars: ish yozishmalari va hisobotlar.

homework_uz: Inglizcha bir xatboshini (o‘zingiz yozgan insho yoki yangilik matnidan) olib, uni beshta qisqartirilgan birikma bilan qayta yozing: sifatdoshli, absolute, qisqartirilgan nisbiy gap yoki predlog + -ing. Mezon: kamida uch xil tur ishlatilgan, birorta sifatdosh osilib qolmagan, ma’no saqlangan va bitta gapda ikkitadan ortiq qisqartirish yo‘q.

options: Walking to work, the rain began.
Walking to work, I was caught in the rain.
Walking to work, it started to rain.
Walked to work, I was caught in the rain.
quiz.why_uz: Sifatdoshli birikmaning egasi asosiy gap egasi bilan bir xil bo‘lishi kerak: men yurganman. Rain va it bilan osilib qolgan sifatdosh hosil bo‘ladi.

quiz.q: ___ the report, she sent it to her manager.
quiz.why_uz: U o‘zi tugatgan va bu oldin bo‘lgan harakat: having + V3. Finished majhul ma’no beradi.

quiz.q: ___ in 1890, the bridge is still in use today.
quiz.why_uz: Ko‘prikni qurishgan, majhul ma’no: built. Building yoki having built ko‘prik o‘zi qurgandek qiladi.

options: Being Sunday, the shops were closed.
It being Sunday, the shops were closed.
Been Sunday, the shops were closed.
Being it Sunday, the shops were closed.
quiz.why_uz: Absolute birikmada o‘z ega bo‘lishi shart: it being Sunday. Egasiz being Sunday do‘konlarni yakshanba qilib qo‘yadi.

quiz.q: ___ prices rising, many families are cutting back.
quiz.why_uz: With + ot + -ing absolute birikma: narxlar o‘sayotgani sababli. Because dan keyin to‘liq gap kerak.

quiz.q: Reduce: 'The report which was published last week was criticised.'
options: The published last week report was criticised.
The report publishing last week was criticised.
The report published last week was criticised.
The report to publish last week was criticised.
quiz.why_uz: Majhul nisbiy gap uchinchi shaklga qisqaradi va qo‘shimcha so‘zlar bo‘lgani uchun otdan keyin turadi.

quiz.q: She was the first woman ___ the prize.
quiz.why_uz: The first, the last, the only dan keyin to-infinitive ishlatiladi: the first woman to win.

quiz.q: The roads ___ are closed, so take another route.
quiz.why_uz: Ta’mir hozir davom etmoqda va yo‘llarni ta’mirlashmoqda: being + V3. Repairing yo‘l o‘zi ta’mirlayotgandek bo‘ladi.
Predlogdan keyin fe’l doim -ing shaklida: without saying. Without to say rus tilidagi infinitive ta’siridagi xato.

options: Feeling tired, he went to bed.
The factory closed, leaving 500 people without work.
quiz.why_uz: Gap oxiridagi , leaving … birikmasi butun oldingi gapning natijasini bildiradi. Qolganlari sabab, ketma-ketlik va shart.
